# ONT/ONU and modem vendors

Relevant families include ZTE, CDATA, VSOL, FiberHome, Nokia, Huawei, and other operator/inventory-specific devices.

For every exact model, confirm:
- PON type (GPON/EPON/XGS-PON), optical class, ports, Wi-Fi capability, firmware and operator profile.
- Registration state, serial/LOID/password provisioning state, OMCI/management status.
- Optical RX/TX readings and vendor/operator limits; do not use generic thresholds.
- LOS/LOF/PON alarms, WAN mode, VLAN, PPPoE/IPoE, bridge/router mode, DHCP, NAT, LAN, Wi-Fi, and ACS/TR-069 support.
- Customer-specific identifiers must be redacted in shared diagnostics.
